titleEn: A Bite from Every Lunchbox Section!

pages.text: "No beans! Just egg and rice!" Bami opened a three-section lunchbox by the dining-car window and pecked only at egg and rice. Nabi the train cat dozed, curled on a window cushion.
"No peas! No spinach!" Bami snapped the lid shut. Mom, wearing her dining-car apron, looked worried. Nabi only yawned.
Next morning, Bami had no energy. Even flying up to the roof was hard; their wings felt heavy. "Where did my strength go?" Bami wondered.
Mom opened the dining-car window. "Look outside." Spring fields were full of grass. A fawn grazed, then bounced about. Bami's eyes widened.
Mom whispered, "Grass and beans hide strength. Grass helps that fawn jump; beans help Bami fly to the roof!" Really? Bami swallowed eagerly. Nabi watched through narrow eyes.
At lunchtime, the train stopped at a station. Mom set down a lunchbox full of beans and sang, "A bite from every lunchbox section!" Rice, egg, and beans shone side by side. Bami studied them.
Bami bravely pecked a pea. "Oh! Sweet!" Spinach tasted better than expected, too. Bami joined the song. "A bite from every lunchbox section!"
How strange! Heavy wings felt light and Bami's eyes sparkled. Wings wide, they flew to the roof. Their strength was back!
Next lunchtime, Bami called first. "Beans first today, Mom! One, a bite of beans! Two, a bite of egg! Three, go around and try every section!" Mom smiled.
Mom cuddled Bami. "Eating everything helped you fly to the roof!" Eating the bean section helped Bami's wings grow strong. At the last stop, Bami flew up again. A bite from every lunchbox section!
